commit.message:
docs(rip-0001): updates and add canonical authority declarations

Appointment section:
- Set appointment threshold to the majority of Core Strategic
  Authority members (concurrence of Founder always required),
  providing a balanced bar between MINOR (1 vote) and MAJOR
  (unanimous) thresholds that scales naturally as the team grows.

Add §Unauthorized Editorial Actions:
- Explicitly state that assigning RIP numbers, publishing revisions,
  or representing materials as official RIPs without proper editorial
  appointment constitutes unauthorized action.
- Disclaim Core Team responsibility for content published in
  unauthorized forks or external repositories claiming RIP status.
- Clarify that such materials carry no governance authority and
  must not be treated as official Rincoin protocol documentation.
- Reference canonical sources (rips.rincoin.org and GitHub
  repository) as the authoritative counterpart to unauthorized forks.

Add canonical URL fields to RIP header metadata:
- Canonical-URL: https://rips.rincoin.org
- Repository: https://github.com/Aevust/rincoin-rips

No changes to consensus rules, version numbering, voting thresholds,
succession procedure, or any other normative section of this RIP.

+Additional editors are appointed by the **Founder and Core Strategic Authority** following a probationary period of at least 90 days during which the candidate demonstrates technical contribution and good-faith engagement with the development community. Appointment requires concurrence of the Founder and a majority of Core Strategic Authority members. Community consultation serves an advisory role; final appointment authority rests with the Founder and Core Strategic Authority.
 
 This structure mirrors the practice of Bitcoin's BIP process (appointment by existing editors and project leadership, informed by community feedback) and Ethereum's EIP process (candidate identification by existing editors, trial period, technical merit verification), adapted for Rincoin's governance model.
 
@@ -406,6 +408,16 @@ The Core Role governance structure introduces additional security considerations
 - **Denial-of-service via objection campaigns**: The "verbal objections do not block" rule in Step 3 of the Succession procedure prevents an adversary from weaponizing the notice period to indefinitely stall legitimate reconstitution.
 - **Key compromise of Core Role holders**: Mitigated by the `SECURITY.md` key-rotation procedure, which is decoupled from this RIP so that key rotation does not require amending the governance specification.
 
+#### Unauthorized Editorial Actions
+
+Any individual who assigns RIP numbers, publishes RIP revisions, or represents materials as official Rincoin Improvement Proposals without proper editorial appointment (as defined above) is acting without authority.
+
+The Core Team assumes no responsibility for content published in unauthorized forks or external repositories claiming RIP status. Such materials carry no governance authority and should not be treated as official Rincoin protocol documentation.
+
+**The authoritative source for all official RIPs is:**
+- Web: [rips.rincoin.org](https://rips.rincoin.org)
+- Repository: [github.com/Aevust/rincoin-rips](https://github.com/Aevust/rincoin-rips)
